KeyV save/restore of legacy camera angles (_legacyCam) confirmed in NavComputer.js; 157/157 tests pass across 3 files once re-run in isolation (a first contended run had produced spurious failures from a sibling process editing the same files). contract.json still marks this live:true; adversarial review judged headless evidence sufficient.

contextmenu listener (preventDefault + same 25-texel drag threshold as the old right-click branch + handleEscape) confirmed in the NavComputer.js constructor; 7/7 targeted jsdom tests pass across all three looks. HERE·SECTOR locator (navViewModes/index.js) now unconditionally eats a SYSTEM-level click (recentre skipped; selection/frame/chip left untouched), with recentrePlayer()'s own independent level-4 refusal as a second gate. 10/10 targeted tests pass across two files.

Star-multiplicity fill (`mult`) memoized by seed, plus the COMPS sort comparator, confirmed in state.js/designs.js; targeted tests 3/3 pass and a broader 58/76 run showed zero assertion failures (remaining gaps were vitest worker-fork crashes, a known WSL resource issue, not defects). Recommend reproducing the pass in an isolated checkout, the technique already used for AC-2's authoritative run, before trusting it.

Commit-bar/tab-band row separation (tabY=228 vs commitY=234 in geometry.js, drawn one texel apart in designs.js, hit-test ordering fixed in navViewModes/index.js) confirmed; extractor `--check` green; 2/2 targeted tests pass, including a real click-path case distinguishing the commit rect from the tab strip by one texel.

All named key legends (design 1 PRISM/SYSTEM hints, both designs' 'V LOOK SHIFT+TAB BACK ESC CLOSE' legend, design 2's sort/page/list keys) confirmed in designs.js; 12/12 dedicated tests pass plus 55 more in adjacent suites (3 unrelated timeouts under memory pressure). Adversarial review returned only 1/3 sufficient, most likely for the same non-quiescent-tree reason as AC-10/AC-21 — recommend a clean isolated re-run before closing.

remapClick's new drag guard (refuses any point >5 texels from the recorded mousedown, keyboard-Tab exempted via synthClick) sits before every acting branch; 12/12 targeted tests pass covering the pager, the locator, and a drawn-search release. One gap disclosed, not tested directly: the list-header-sort and ladder-end-cap controls are inferred (not proven) safe by the same control-flow position.

deactivate() now delegates to the driver's onDeactivate(), which resets search/levelLag/levelArm/pick/listOffset while preserving sort/list/zoom preferences; 54/54 tests pass across the only 3 files in the repo that reference this path.

_handleMouseUp now also clears _dragStartLadder (previously only re-armed, never released), closing the stale-ladder-scrub gap from review item C8. 5/5 targeted tests pass deterministically, reproducing the exact stale-press-then-later-SYSTEM-gesture sequence.

KeyV now resets _systemMode/_selectedComponentIdx/_componentView whenever the NEW look is a design (not when returning to legacy). 5/5 targeted tests pass, and a mutation/liveness probe (deleting the fix on a scratch copy) reproduced exactly the AC's defect shape in 3/5 cases — confirms the tests are not vacuous.

Math.round→Math.floor at all 4 named hit-test sites (search.js rowAt + 3 in navViewModes/index.js listRowAt), independently re-derived against the actual per-row draw offset rather than trusted from the diff's own comments. 9/9 targeted tests pass across 3 files.

Design 2's SECTOR/REGION status line now measures its fixed clauses first and truncates only the variable sector name, preserving 'CLICK TO ENTER'; extractor --check green; 4/4 tests pass. The AC statement's own line-number citation is stale (file has grown since authoring) but the substantive fix and dedicated test agree.

New clipBox/rectClip/frameClip/spriteClip primitives keep the YOU marker and target diamond inside the map pane at both the top-level 2D map and the band/block sub-view. A real 200-texel-pan test plus a mark-guard assertion (0 violations at GALAXY/SECTOR/REGION) pass; extractor sync confirmed.

Ladder and rail now derive body letters from one shared AU-ordered function (d1LadderOrder/d1BodyTagger) independent of the active sort key; moons resolve to their parent's letter via the shared `au` field. A test driving the real `]` key through all 3 sort keys on a 5-planet/3-moon system confirms ladder tag == rail tag for every body under every sort.

chord() gate (Ctrl/Meta/Alt) added to search's printable()/key() and to the V/L host handler, so those chords are neither typed into the query nor preventDefault'd; 6/6 targeted tests pass. Adversarial review returned 0/3 sufficient. Note: contract.json itself marks this AC only '◐ partial by design,' not '✅ built' — the WASDRF pan-key clause deliberately keeps eating Ctrl+W/Ctrl+R/Ctrl+S on purpose (letting them through would let a pilot close the tab or reload the game from inside a full-screen overlay). That looks like a documented, accepted scope exception rather than an open defect; the contract's acceptance text should say so explicitly rather than leave the AC reading as unmet.

KeyV now runs the same gesture-release fields _handleMouseUp does (_dragging, _panStartCenter, gauge/counter drags, _dragStartLadder), so pressing V mid-drag ends the gesture instead of carrying stale coordinates into the new canvas buffer. 8/8 targeted tests pass, including the exact mismatched-CSS-box scenario (2021x1162 vs 417x240) from the original review.
